title: navarretia glutinosa
intro: Navarretia glutinosa, commonly known as sticky piperess, is a plant species native to the western United States and Canada. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Navarretia glutinosa include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe wounds and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as astringency and anti-inflammatory effects.
